verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Notion is used as a project/initiative tracker by teams (comm-6, comm-15, comm-3), consistent with its flexible database model that supports custom fields like status, priority, and owner, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation explicitly describing status/priority/owning-team properties, and one community report notes hitting limits when using Notion as a project/issue tracker. Missing for 10: explicit docs on database property types (status, priority, person/team fields), and independent confirmation of scaling well for initiative tracking at team level.
